name: Drugged
body:
Drugged (Su)
Source Heroes of Golarion pg. 16
The witch can combine her magic with her poisons to weaken her enemies’ minds. When the witch creates a poison, she can require the target of the poison to attempt a Will save rather than a Fortitude save. The witch must use this hex when she crafts the poison, and once used, the hex can’t be undone without remaking the poison.
